question: Several press reports have revealed possible irregularities and suspected corruption pertaining to tendering procedures at the College of Europe in Bruges. The Belgian authorities are also currently investigating the former Vice-President / High Representative for Foreign Affairs and Security Policy, Federica Mogherini, for fraud and corruption.

When did the Commission or its Vice-President / High Representative, Kaja Kallas, become aware of the allegations reported in the media of alleged irregularities and corruption at the College of Europe, and how did they obtain this information?
answer: EN on behalf of the European Commission (20.1.2026) The High Representative/Vice-President (HR/VP) reiterates the full cooperation of the European External Action Service with the investigation, in complete transparency. The HR/VP has full confidence in the competent authorities that the due process is observed and that the presumption of innocence is maintained. As the investigation is ongoing, the HR/VP cannot comment on further details.
